title: 工業力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics II
keywords: Motion of Mass Points 2.Laws of Motion 3.Inertial, Centripetal, and Centrifugal Forces 4.Moment of Inertia 5.Planar Motion of Rigid Body
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn Newton's laws of motion, and (2) learn the fundamentals of dynamics (motion of mass points and rigid bodies against external forces and moments). Since mechanics is the basis of mechanical engineering, it is essential to understanding any courses focused on mechanical engineering. Students will therefore acquire knowledge on topics such as inertia that are necessary for the design of high-speed machines.
advice: This course covers the basics of the statics and dynamics of objects. We will cover the following topics: 1. Linear motion of mass points 2. Planar motion of mass points 3. Laws of motion 4. Inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces 5. The moment of inertia 6. Planar motion of rigid bodies Students will learn the method of analysis of the motion of mass points and rigid bodies by setting up and solving equations of motion through exercises based on the items listed above. Students are required to understand these concepts, tackle practice problems, and then cultivate the ability to apply their knowledge to practical problems. Students are also required to tackle exercises using schematic drawings, and then imagine the application of forces and moments and the subsequent motion of mass points and rigid bodies. Students are expected to pay attention to significant figures and units.
books: Textbooks: Engineering Mechanics, 3rd edition/New edition, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese), Reference books: Introduction to Dynamics, Baifukan Co., Ltd. (in Japanese), Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of "Engineering Mechanics I", Enough skill of mathematics (especially differential and integral calculus, inner and outer products of vectors), Basic knowledge of mechanics (kinematics and moment of force)

activityGoals.body: Be able to set up equations of motion of mass points, and calculate their velocity and position.
Be able to explain laws of motion, and calculate inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces.
Be able to calculate moment of inertia.
Be able to set up equations of motion for mechanical models.
Be able to solve equations of motion by applying mathematics, and explain dynamic behavior of mechanical models.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Set up equations of motion for any motion, and solve them. (2) Explain laws of motion, and calculate inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces. (3) Calculate moment of inertia of complex-shaped objects. (4) Set up equations of motion for mechanical models, solve them by applying mathematics, and explain their dynamic behavior.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Set up equations of uniformly accelerated motion of mass point, and solve them. (2) Explain laws of motion, and calculate inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces. (3) Utilize formulas for moment of inertia. (4) Set up equations of motion for simple mechanical models, solve them.
